## Piece or interaction

Which piece, matchup, or collision is affected?

## Observed behavior

Include launch direction, approximate power, impacts, and resulting damage.

## Expected behavior

Explain why the result seems too strong, weak, predictable, or inconsistent.

## Reproduction

Describe the shortest repeatable setup, including game mode and board state.

## Evidence

Attach a replay, screenshot, or relevant test output when available.
